title: Cologne Game Lab
subtitle: BA Digital Games, Game Programming — TH Köln
description: Seven semesters of project-based games education at TH Köln's Cologne Game Lab, taught and examined in English.
timelineDescription: A degree built on shipped team projects rather than coursework alone.

workTopics.title: Collaborative Project Series
workTopics.description: Five semester-long team productions, each built by a cross-disciplinary group of programmers, designers and artists around a different design brief.
highlights: Ludic Games, Narrative Games and Mixed Reality Games in years one and two
Experimental Games and Serious Games in the later semesters
Cross-disciplinary teams — the same collaboration model as a small studio
Mainly C# in Unity, with one mixed-reality project in Unreal Engine

workTopics.title: Self-Initiated Project
workTopics.description: A full semester dedicated to a single self-directed production — the largest individual module of the degree at 25 ECTS.
highlights: Self-defined scope, schedule and technical direction
Largest single module of the programme (25 ECTS)
Direct precursor to the freelance prototyping work that followed

workTopics.title: Bachelor Thesis
workTopics.description: Thesis on character scale and movement constraints in digital games — how body proportions and traversal rules interact with level geometry.
highlights: "Resolving character sizing issues and movement limitations in digital games"
Combined practical implementation with written research
Graduated B.A. Digital Games, Game Programming, July 2019

title: Rough Justice: '84
subtitle: Lead Programmer — Gamma Minus UG
description: Agency management game built in Unreal Engine 4 with an international remote team. Published by Daedalic Entertainment.
timelineDescription: Technical lead on a shipped UE4 title, from data-driven core architecture to team leadership.

workTopics.title: Data-driven Core Architecture
workTopics.description: Designed the C++ core simulating time and resource flows, with modular systems for contracts, dialogue and agent management.
highlights: Simulation of time and resource flows as the game's backbone
Separate modules for contract, dialogue and agent management
Data-driven design so designers could iterate without engineering support
C++17 on Unreal Engine 4

workTopics.title: Technical Leadership & Tooling
workTopics.description: Led a three-person junior team while building the tooling that removed manual setup work from the production pipeline.
highlights: Code reviews, requirements analysis and ticket planning for three junior engineers
Designed the technical hiring tests used to grow the team
Built a procedural generation tool driven by network data
Worked in an international, fully remote team

title: Everslaught Invasion
subtitle: Software Engineer — MobX Games
description: VR action title for Meta Quest 2, published by Fast Travel Games. Network-synchronised real-time systems inside a standalone headset's memory and performance budget.
timelineDescription: Agent AI and P2P network synchronisation under standalone VR constraints.

workTopics.title: Autonomous Agent AI Framework
workTopics.description: Built a behaviour-tree-based framework for autonomous agents, covering navigation and rule-driven spawning.
highlights: Behaviour-tree architecture for autonomous agent decision-making
Path and terrain navigation for agents in 3D space
Rule-based spawn system driving encounter pacing
Designed for reuse across multiple agent types

workTopics.title: Real-time Network Synchronisation
workTopics.description: Implemented peer-to-peer state replication over Photon Fusion, kept stable within the tight budgets of a standalone headset.
highlights: State replication for 10+ agents in real time over Photon Fusion P2P
Lean state design to stay inside standalone VR memory budgets
Custom object pooling to avoid runtime allocation spikes
Refactored session management: lobby, join flow and matchmaking

Linux back end via Vulkan, DRM and Xorg
A single API surface over two very different platform models
Adopted by several products across the toolchain

C++20 with CMake, Docker and unit testing; SIL/HIL workflows in a Scrum/SAFe setting
